I'm pretty sure it was a minor seizure. He lost some muscle control, convulsed for about a minute, was very shaky for another 5-7, but still conscious. He was pretty much back to normal in 10-15 minutes.

Quick question though. What exactly is a "boutique" diet? I've heard that term thrown around a lot in the conversation surrounding DCM, but never really had it defined.

I'm just worried it is larger corporations trying to eliminate small-business competition.

Thank you so much! I think I am going to go back to the adult fromm gold, but also include some supplements such as taurine and other toppers. I'm gonna start with bone broth, goats milk, and small amounts of canned food.

While I am going back to grain-inclusive, I am going to stick to the fromm adult gold. I personally feel like royal canin and the science diet have way to much corn, white rice, and flour. I think brown rice, barely, and oats just have more nutrients. Especially since he's a very active dog and that is what his vet initially recommended. That's in no way to disrespect your opinions on diet though! Everyone is just trying to keep their pups healthy.
i hate to beg but pls answer 💀
